PMFBYGrievance-v0.1.name: PMFBYGrievance
PMFBYGrievance-v0.1.description: Attributes for grievances raised against the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana crop insurance scheme. This is an API schema, not a domain schema: it describes what the PMFBY grievance API accepts and returns, so an experience layer can call it without reading adapter mapping files. Attaches through commitmentAttributes: a grievance is a promise with a lifecycle of its own, not a catalogable resource. Direction is carried by informationMode, never by the Beckn action. OnDemand is the ask, Direct is an answer carrying a real case. The same attributes serve init, confirm, select and status without change. On support the payload attaches through channels instead, and three fields move into the Support object itself. x-beckn-container-by-action says which container each action uses, and the per-field x-beckn-path says where a field that moves ends up.

pack_fields.description: Direction of this payload. OnDemand is the ask; Direct is an answer carrying a real case. Held locally rather than inherited from AgricultureResource, whose definition is framed around a Resource that holds information; here it says which way a commitment payload is travelling.
Canonical OAN type, optionally accompanied by Provider-defined JSON-LD types.
A Beckn Descriptor with at least a machine-readable code or human-readable name.

Mobile number of the farmer raising the grievance, and the number the portal sends the OTP to. Ten digits, Indian mobile series. Never returned in a response; on_init carries the masked otpChallenge.sentTo instead.
PMFBY crop insurance application number the grievance concerns.

Crop year of the application, as a four-digit year. The portal returns request_year as a number, so the adapter stringifies it on the way back. It is the year of the application, not of the grievance: a 2025 crop year can carry a 2026 complaint date.

Crop season of the application. PMFBY accepts three seasons and nothing else. The network carries the name; the adapter maps it to the numeric request_season the portal wants -- Kharif 1, Rabi 2, Zaid 3. Summer is the same season as Zaid and is sent as Zaid.
A Beckn Descriptor with at least a machine-readable code or human-readable name.

pack_fields.requirement: At least one of code or name

pack_fields.example: "Claim approved in July but no amount has been credited to my account."

beckn_path.status: message.contract.descriptor.longDesc, but only on the support flow; on the contract flow it stays here

pack_fields.description: One-time password the portal sent to applicantPhone, presented to prove the number. PMFBY issues exactly six digits and rejects any other length. writeOnly is the contract: it travels inbound only. It must never be returned in any response, written to a log, or attached to a trace, and it is never forwarded to the lodge call.

Portal grievance ticket number. Returned when a grievance is filed and presented again to read its replies, so it travels in both directions. Digits only, and long enough not to be mistaken for a phone number: the live system routes a ten-digit answer to the phone and anything longer to the ticket, and observed tickets run twelve to fifteen digits. The length is not pinned because that range is described as typical, not as a rule.

The portal's internal key for the same ticket. PMFBY's lodge reply carries both ticket-no and ticket-id; ticketNo is the number a farmer is told and quotes back, this is the portal's own row id. Returned only; nothing sends it, and no later call is known to need it. Modelled so the lodge reply is fully accounted for.
A Beckn Descriptor with at least a machine-readable code or human-readable name.
Date the grievance was filed with the portal.

The reviewing officer's response, taken from the portal's latest remark. The portal sends an empty string while no reply exists; the adapter omits the field rather than passing the empty string through, so an absent field reads as "not yet answered". There is no companion reply date -- PMFBY publishes none -- so this pack has no repliedOn.
Reference to the authoritative upstream source of information.
Stable identifier of the upstream source.
Human-readable source name.
Authoritative public or Provider-supplied source URI.
Acknowledgement that the portal has sent an OTP. Carries no secret: sentTo is the masked destination so the farmer can confirm which number was used, and the OTP itself is never returned.
The destination number, masked. First two and last two digits only; the six between them are always X.
When the OTP stops being accepted.

PMKISANGrievance-v0.1.name: PMKISANGrievance
PMKISANGrievance-v0.1.description: Attributes for grievances raised against Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi. This is an API schema, not a domain schema: it describes what the PM-KISAN grievance API accepts and returns, so an experience layer can call it without reading adapter mapping files. Attaches through commitmentAttributes: a grievance is a promise with a lifecycle of its own, not a catalogable resource. Direction is carried by informationMode, never by the Beckn action. OnDemand is the ask, Direct is an answer carrying a real case. The same attributes serve confirm, select and status without change. On support the payload attaches through channels instead, and two fields move into the Support object itself. x-beckn-container-by-action says which container each action uses, and the per-field x-beckn-path says where a field that moves ends up. Nothing here identifies a single case the way PMFBY's ticketNo does: neither the lodge reply nor a status record carries a case identifier. A grievance is retrieved by the identity it was filed under, and every grievance on that identity comes back together.

pack_fields.description: Direction of this payload. OnDemand is the ask; Direct is an answer carrying a real case. Held locally rather than inherited from AgricultureResource, whose definition is framed around a Resource that holds information; here it says which way a commitment payload is travelling.
Canonical OAN type, optionally accompanied by Provider-defined JSON-LD types.
A Beckn Descriptor with at least a machine-readable code or human-readable name.

The PM-KISAN registration number the grievance is filed under, and the only identity this pack accepts. Aadhaar is deliberately not offered: nothing in the grievance flow requires one, so asking for one would collect an identifier the network has no use for.
writeOnly is the contract: it travels inbound only. It is never returned, logged, or attached to a trace -- the farmer supplied it and does not need it read back.
The rule is only non-empty and alphanumeric. Eleven alphanumeric characters is the documented shape, but nothing upstream enforces it, and a length rule taken from a tool docstring would reject a valid grievance before the farmer's complaint reached the portal. ASCII-only is on purpose: the upstream accepts Devanagari and other native-script digits and forwards them unconverted.
A Beckn Descriptor with at least a machine-readable code or human-readable name.
